name: dotnet-test-monorepo
description: Monorepo combining .NET backend (Week 1-3) and Vue frontend (Week 4)

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "cd backend && dotnet run" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.db:reset: pkill -f 'dotnet run' ; sleep 2 ; docker exec -u postgres dotnet-test-db psql -d postgres -c "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = 'dotnet_test' AND pid <> pg_backend_pid();" && docker exec -u postgres dotnet-test-db psql -d postgres -c 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS dotnet_test;' && cd backend && rm -rf bin obj && dotnet build
